models_evaluated: sparse machine learning model trained on clinical information

links.outcome: Generalization of depressive symptom prediction model across diverse inpatient and outpatient samples
links.effect: Sparse model trained on clinical information generalized strongly across diverse real-world samples despite systematic differences between samples; no numbers in abstract.
links.quote: Despite systematic differences between samples, a sparse machine learning model trained on clinical information exhibited strong generalization across diverse real-world samples.

unlisted_practices: Harmonized, structured routine clinical data collection based on unified ontologies
Sparse models with stringent measures against overfitting to aid generalization

screen.reason: The study empirically tests whether harmonized, structured data collection protocols and specific anti-overfitting constraints facilitate model generalizability across real-world clinical psychiatric cohorts.

primary.practice: standardized routine data collection and anti-overfitting measures
